lines.text: You've zipped this ten thousand times. How does it actually work?
Zoom in. Two rows of tiny hooks, offset by half a step.
The slider is a Y-shaped funnel.
A wedge inside squeezes the teeth together.
Reverse it, and the wedge pries them apart.
So why don't they just pull apart?
Each bulb is wider than the gap, so it jams.
The slider is a wedge: tiny tug, huge grip.
Stuck? Rub a pencil along the teeth.
Watch again, and see if you can spot the wedge.
